svg.text: JEDDAH, SAUDI ARABIA / OEJN / AIRPORT CONTEXT & STUDY SCOPE

g.text: Geographic footprints · illustrative heights 12 / 20 m · vertical emphasis 4×

svg.text: Opposite designators refer to the same
The initiative concentrates on the central and western runways: 34C/16C and 34L/16R.
The eastern runway, 34R/16L, remains visible to explain the full airport system.
Building forms follow mapped footprints. Heights and flat terrain are illustrative, not surveyed.
SOURCE SANS eAIP · AIRAC 10/26 · effective 01 Oct 2026 · AD 2.12 / 2.13 / 2.22
